name: DINOv3-SAT fixed one-shot 20-query benchmark
coordinate_units_note: Distance uses numeric coordinates parsed from filenames; their physical unit has not been independently verified.
query_selection: Deterministic greedy farthest-point sampling in filename-coordinate Euclidean space. Start with the eligible image farthest from support, then repeatedly select the image maximizing its minimum distance to the selected set; break ties by filename. Masks and model scores are not used for selection.
